farm: BEL Sainte Ode wind farm = Saint Ode (Aspiravi) wind farm
why_zh: 兩筆都是 Aspiravi 在 Sainte-Ode 的 18 MW 風場，GEM 兩頁引用同一個 Aspiravi 專案頁（sainte-ode-2）。Aspiravi 只有一座 Sainte-Ode 風場：5 部風機、18 MW；The Wind Power 在當地也只有一組 5 部、18,000 kW 的營運中機組（其餘是已拆除的 Dewind 與另一組 Fuhrländer），座標與保留的那筆（50.046, 5.578）相同。另一筆座標落在舊機組位置。商轉年：Aspiravi 頁面同時寫「2023 In operation」與「2024 年開始發電」，不改。
why_en: Both are Aspiravi's 18 MW Sainte-Ode farm; both GEM pages cite the same Aspiravi project page (sainte-ode-2). Aspiravi has one Sainte-Ode farm of 5 turbines and 18 MW, and The Wind Power shows a single operating 5-turbine, 18,000 kW part there (the rest are dismantled Dewinds and a separate Fuhrländer group), at the coordinates of the kept record (50.046, 5.578); the other record sits on the older turbines. Year left as is: Aspiravi's page says both '2023 In operation' and that the turbines 'will start generating green electricity in 2024'.

farm: DEU Oettelin wind farm = Ottelin wind farm
why_zh: 兩筆座標完全相同（53.864, 12.088，GEM 兩頁都取自 Esri 的同一個點）、都是 20 MW。The Wind Power 在 Oettelin／Kassow 只有一座 20 MW 風場：8 部 Nordex N100/2500，座標同一處；附近其他風場（Groß Schwiesow - Oettelin 6.9 MW、Mistorf 等）容量都不同。「Ottelin」是拼錯的地名，保留「Oettelin」。業主：Enertrag 是開發商，GEM 另一頁依 Terravent 的持股清單寫 Terravent Deutschland，但 Terravent 網站連不上無法核對，業主不改，待查證。
why_en: Identical coordinates (53.864, 12.088; both GEM pages take the same Esri point) and the same 20 MW. The Wind Power has one 20 MW farm at Oettelin/Kassow, 8 Nordex N100/2500 at that point; the other farms around (Groß Schwiesow - Oettelin 6.9 MW, Mistorf and so on) differ in size. 'Ottelin' misspells the village, so keep 'Oettelin'. Owner: Enertrag developed it; the other GEM page names Terravent Deutschland from Terravent's holdings list, but terravent.ch could not be reached to check, so the owner is left unchanged (to be verified).

farm: DEU Mangelsdorf (Envia) wind farm = Mangelsdorf wind farm
why_zh: 不是重複。BOREAS 在 2014 年 12 月於 Mangelsdorf 建了 8 部 Vestas V112（輪轂 140 m），分成兩座各 4 部、約 12 MW 的風場：enercity 2015 年向 BOREAS 買下其中 4 部（Windpark Mangelsdorf，12 MW），另外 4 部由 BOREAS 持多數股權並營運，登記為 Windkraft Jerichow-Mangelsdorf I GmbH & Co. KG（4 部、12,300 kW，2014-12-15 起）。GEM 的「Envia」那筆就是後者（營運者寫 Windpark Jerichow-Mangelsdorf I），但寫成 Envia 100% 持有不正確（enercity 說多數股權在 BOREAS），待查證。另注意：turbines_de.json 把 2002 年的 9 部 Nordex N62 配給了「Mangelsdorf (Envia)」、把一組 2014 年的 V112 配給了 2002 年的「Mangelsdorf (PNE)」，似乎配錯，建議檢查 build_mastr.py 的配對。
why_en: Not a duplicate. BOREAS built eight Vestas V112 (140 m hub) at Mangelsdorf in December 2014 as two farms of four turbines and about 12 MW each: enercity bought four from BOREAS in 2015 (Windpark Mangelsdorf, 12 MW), and BOREAS kept a majority in and runs the other four, registered as Windkraft Jerichow-Mangelsdorf I GmbH & Co. KG (4 units, 12,300 kW, active from 15 Dec 2014). GEM's 'Envia' record is that second farm (its operator is Windpark Jerichow-Mangelsdorf I), but 'Envia 100%' looks wrong since enercity says BOREAS holds the majority (to be verified). Also: turbines_de.json assigns the nine 2002 Nordex N62 to 'Mangelsdorf (Envia)' and a 2014 V112 group to the 2002 'Mangelsdorf (PNE)' record, which looks like a mismatch worth checking in build_mastr.py.

sources.quote: Die vier Windenergieanlagen aus dem Windpark Mangelsdorf in Sachsen-Anhalt (Landkreis Jerichower Land) haben eine Gesamtleistung von 12 MW. Der Windpark besteht aus Windenergieanlagen des Typs Vestas V 112 mit einer Nabenhöhe von 140 Metern
Die vier Anlagen sind Teil eines Gesamtprojektes mit acht Windenergieanlagen. Entwickelt wurde der Park von der BOREAS Energie GmbH.
Neben der Mehrheitsbeteiligung an den weiteren vier Anlagen und deren Betriebsführung übernimmt BOREAS für die enercity-Anlagen die technische Betriebsführung
Windkraft Jerichow-Mangelsdorf I GmbH & Co. KG Burg (Saxony Anhalt), Germany 12.300 kW Total installed capacity 15.12.2014 Start of activity 4 Onshore installations
Boreas hat im Dezember die Anlagen bei Mangelsdorf in Betrieb genommen

why_en: There is one Les Hauts Pays farm around Epizon (Haute-Marne): 39 Repower MM92 Evo (2,050 kW) in three parts (Haut du Mont, Mont Doré, Pays Crémont), 79.95 MW in all. GEM has it once at 80 MW (approximate point) and once at 78 MW (39 x 2 MW). Keep the record with the precise point and set 80 MW (79.95).

farm: FRA Montagne Ardéchoise wind farm = La Montagne Ardéchoise wind farm
why_zh: 兩筆相距約 0.3 km，都是 EDF 的 Montagne Ardéchoise 風場。EDF 說明這座風場橫跨六個市鎮、29 部風機、73.5 MW；The Wind Power 也只列一座（東、北、南三區共 29 部 Enercon E82，73.35 MW）。Pradelles 擴建另有一筆規劃中紀錄，不受影響。保留容量寫 73.5 MW 的那筆。
why_en: About 0.3 km apart, both are EDF's Montagne Ardéchoise farm. EDF describes one farm across six communes with 29 turbines and 73.5 MW, and The Wind Power lists one farm (East, North and South parts, 29 Enercon E82, 73.35 MW). The separate Pradelles extension record is unaffected. Keep the record with 73.5 MW.

sources.quote: L’installation renouvelable comprend 29 turbines pour une puissance installée de 73,5 MW.

farm: FRA Egrouettes wind farm = Les Egrouettes wind farm
why_zh: 兩筆都是 Voves（今 Les Villages Vovéens）的 33.6 MW，相距約 2.4 km。當地是 8 部風機一組：CNR 的 Les Egrouettes 5 部（2020 年 1 月商轉）加上相鄰的「Un souffle dans la plaine」3 部；The Wind Power 也列成同一座的本體 5 部＋擴建 3 部。33.6 MW 是 8 部的合計，兩筆都描述這同一組。VOL-V（Vent Solaire）2019 年併入 CNR，兩筆業主其實是同一家。保留 CNR 那筆；商轉年（2020 vs 2021）與 33.6 MW 是否含鄰場，待查證。
why_en: Both are 33.6 MW at Voves (now Les Villages Vovéens), about 2.4 km apart. The site is one group of eight turbines: CNR's Les Egrouettes with five (commissioned January 2020) plus the neighbouring 'Un souffle dans la plaine' with three; The Wind Power also lists them as one farm, five plus a three-turbine extension. 33.6 MW is the eight-turbine total, which both records describe. VOL-V (Vent Solaire) joined CNR in 2019, so both owners are the same company. Keep the CNR record; the year (2020 vs 2021) and whether 33.6 MW should include the neighbour remain to be verified.

why_en: Identical point, capacity, year and owner; only the spelling differs. Boralex has one Chemin de Grès farm: 9 turbines, 29.7 MW, around Saint-Hilaire-lez-Cambrai, commissioned 2017. Keep the correctly spelled record and set 29.7 MW.

sources.quote: the Chemin de Grès wind farm consists of 9 wind turbines with a total capacity of 29.7 MW. Commissioned in 2017

farm: FRA Les Monts D'Ain wind farm = Monts De L'Ain wind farm
why_zh: Cerdon、Izenave、Vieu-d'Izenave、Labalme 一帶只有一座 Monts de l'Ain 風場：2012 年核准 9 部，2017 年 11 月商轉，18 MW（E9 在 2018 年遭縱火後沒有重建，現有 8 部）。The Wind Power 也只有一座（18.2 MW），座標與保留的那筆相同；另一筆是概略座標。業主寫法不同（RES 是開發商、營運公司為 CEPE des Monts de l'Ain），不改。
why_en: One Monts de l'Ain farm covers Cerdon, Izenave, Vieu-d'Izenave and Labalme: nine turbines consented in 2012, commissioned November 2017, 18 MW (E9 was not rebuilt after an arson attack in 2018, leaving eight). The Wind Power also has one farm (18.2 MW) at the kept record's point; the other record is approximate. Owners differ (RES developed it; the operating company is CEPE des Monts de l'Ain); left unchanged.

farm: FRA Neuil Sur L'Autise wind farm = Nieul sur l'Autise wind farm
why_zh: Nieul-sur-l'Autise（今併入 Rives-d'Autise）只有一座風場：Les Grosses Terres，8 部 Vestas V100/2000，16 MW。兩筆都是 16 MW。「Neuil」是拼錯的地名，但它的座標（46.442, -0.667）與 The Wind Power 的機位（46.4445, -0.6627）一致；另一筆是概略座標。保留座標好的那筆，名稱改成正確拼法、業主沿用另一筆的 IEL Energie（GEM 資料，未另行核對）。GEM 寫 2018 年，網路資料有 2020 年商轉的說法，待查證。
why_en: Nieul-sur-l'Autise (now part of Rives-d'Autise) has one farm, Les Grosses Terres: 8 Vestas V100/2000, 16 MW; both records are 16 MW. 'Neuil' misspells the commune, but that record's point (46.442, -0.667) matches The Wind Power's (46.4445, -0.6627), while the other is approximate. Keep the well-placed record, fix the spelling and carry over the owner IEL Energie from the other record (GEM data, not checked separately). GEM gives 2018; a 2020 start is also reported, to be verified.

farm: FRA Hauteurs De L'Albe wind farm = Hauters De L'Albe wind farm
why_zh: Nelling、Gréning、Léning 有兩座各自登記的風場，都是 3 部 2.3 MW（Enercon E70）、2009 年 9 月 14 日商轉：西邊的 Hauteurs de l'Albe Ouest 由 Energiequelle 營運，東邊的 Nelling-Albe Est 是另一家公司（PARC EOLIEN DE NELLING ALBE EST，Mundolsheim）。GEM 這兩筆一西（Energiequelle）一東，各寫 13.8～14 MW，等於把兩座合計的 13.8 MW 算了兩次。建議兩筆都保留、容量各改為 6.9 MW；「Hauters」是拼錯，東邊那筆業主 P&T Technologie 未能核對。
why_en: Nelling, Gréning and Léning host two separately registered farms, each three 2.3 MW turbines (Enercon E70) commissioned on 14 Sep 2009: Hauteurs de l'Albe Ouest in the west, run by Energiequelle, and Nelling-Albe Est in the east, held by another company (PARC EOLIEN DE NELLING ALBE EST, Mundolsheim). GEM's two records sit one west (Energiequelle) and one east, each at 13.8-14 MW, which counts the 13.8 MW pair twice. Keep both and set each to 6.9 MW; 'Hauters' is a misspelling, and the eastern record's owner P&T Technologie could not be checked.

Ostwind developed it and Zurich's ewz owns it (ewz calls it one of its existing farms). Keep the record with EWZ as owner. (Valeco's Epinette project in the Somme and JPEE's L'Epinette in Eure-et-Loir are other farms.)

why_en: Millac (Vienne) has two neighbouring farms of the same size: JPee's Croix de Chalais and Sergies' Croix de la Mérotte, four Nordex N117 and 12 MW each. Both records here are named Croix de Chalais with JPee as owner, 0.7 km apart, so they are the same farm; Mérotte already has its own record (its owner is given as JPee, while the construction briefing lists Sergies as Mérotte's owner contact; to be verified). why_en: Les Nouillers (Charente-Maritime) has one farm: EOL LES NOUILLERS, five Enercon E70 of 2 MW, 10 MW, commissioned 2014; both records are 10 MW and 2014, about 3 km apart. Keep the precisely placed one. The parent, Régie d'Energie Eolienne, was merged into BOREAS in 2021.

why_zh: REPD 有兩筆（2867「St John Hill」3×2.5 MW；4031「St. Johns Hill」9×0.85 MW），經度相同、相距約 0.55 km、都在 2013 年 3～4 月商轉，GEM 照抄成兩筆。實際上 Kinneff 附近只有一座 St John's Hill 風場：2013 年商轉，9 部 Gamesa G58/850，合計 7.65 MW；3×2.5 MW 那筆應是同一座的另一種登記。保留 9×0.85 MW 那筆，容量改為 7.65 MW。業主說法不一（Auquhirie Land Company、K E Projects、SSE），不改。
why_en: REPD has two rows (2867 'St John Hill', 3 x 2.5 MW; 4031 'St. Johns Hill', 9 x 0.85 MW) on the same longitude, 0.55 km apart, both operational in March-April 2013, which GEM copied as two farms. There is one St John's Hill farm near Kinneff: commissioned 2013, nine Gamesa G58/850, 7.65 MW; the 3 x 2.5 MW row is another listing of it. Keep the 9 x 0.85 MW record and set 7.65 MW. Owners disagree (Auquhirie Land Company, K E Projects, SSE); left unchanged.
